author: MelchiorGaspar (issue reporter), comment of 2016-08-14: 'Ingame Save memory-pack(Extract from zip file)'; Project64 v2.3.0.208 (from the reporter's screenshot in the same thread)
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue)
what_it_is: The reporter's own game on Controller Pak 1: Load Game shows Alaron, Hours 28:6:30, a party of four. Three NAYE notes (publisher '78'). 32768 bytes, one pak. Zip entry dated 2016-08-12 15:20.
note: The game saves only to the Controller Pak. The reporter names the ROM 'Aidyn Chronicles - The First Mage (U)(v1.1).z64', which is No-Intro's (USA) (Rev 1). The pak's ID block is the classic mupen64plus-core template, as Project64 formats paks. Copied unchanged into pak 1 (0x800) of a Mupen64Plus-Next .srm, the game lists the save: proof.png is that check (angrylion), not the author's screenshot.
